title: When the Ember Burns Revisited
author: Sebastian Oyelaran
blurb: Jonah Dunmore, a debt-bound temple scribe, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
